name: Nancy Pelosi

lean.basis: Democratic congresswoman from San Francisco since 1987 and Democratic leader, including two stints as House speaker.

race_2028.basis: Former aides say boosting Newsom for 2028 is one of her next campaigns; she has called him a potential great president.

sources.title: Axios: Pelosi's new campaign: Boost Newsom for 2028

current_role: U.S. representative from California (retiring January 2027); Speaker Emerita
summary: Nancy Pelosi has represented San Francisco in the House since 1987 and was the first woman to serve as speaker (2007–2011, 2019–2023), overseeing both impeachments of Donald Trump. She announced in November 2025 that she would not seek reelection, and has made promoting Gavin Newsom for 2028 one of her causes.
